title: 第5章 苍云岭周家第6章 湖心岛
slug: 全族助我加点我举族飞升天界
content_zh:
李北玄看到李青山这般优秀的信息面板，心中对此更是惊喜不已。
要不是此刻他还在家族大殿之中，他早就高兴的惊呼出声了。
蓝色资质！百分百突破！还有词条提示的强烈建议培养！
这意味着什么！
这意味着他要是对李青山进行培养，一个月之内百分之百能够突破境界！
只要有族人破境，便可以解决他的问题了！
对于李青山的信息面板，李北玄可谓是越看越是满意。
不一会儿，他便看向李青山情不自禁地放声大笑了起来。
“好，好，好啊！”
在场众人面面相觑，全都不解为何老祖突然放声大笑。
而被李北玄看着的李青山，也是不明白为什么老祖看了他好一会儿，便突然放声大笑起来。
他看向老祖并与之对视，眼中满是疑惑之色！
“不愧是我李家的天才子弟，你很不错！”李北玄看向李青山脸上带着笑容，夸赞道。
听到老祖的夸赞，李青山心中顿时一喜，原来刚刚老祖是因为他的资质出众才对他另眼相看的啊！
其他人现在也都看出来老祖为何在刚才会放声大笑了。
原来是因为有族人的天资出众啊！
不过看到那名族人是李青山之后，他们也都释然了。
“爹，这位族人便是我刚才跟你提过一口的天才后辈李青山，也就是我们李家的第六代子弟！”李天行连忙朝着李北玄介绍道。
他也没想到自家老爹一眼便看出了李青山的资质过人之处。
“嗯！”李北玄对他点了点头，脸上的笑意依旧不减。

接着，他看向李天行说道，“天行，将族中的修炼资源全都拿出来吧！
从今日开始，我们的日常修炼便不用再继续节省了！”
“特别是对待我李家的天才子弟，更是不要吝啬灵源，要重点培养！”
李天行闻言，心中顿时一怔，他没想到老爹是这个意思！
有了自家老爹的吩咐，他自然是得应下来，“是，天行知道了！过会我便去安排！”
但转念一想，又感觉到有些不对，便继续对李北玄说道，“但是爹，我们的灵源估计也就够提供族人修炼两月，两月之后我们该怎么办呢？”
李北玄一听，灵源还能支撑他们李家修士修炼两月，虽说有些勉强，但也足够解他的燃眉之急了。
于是他看向李天行说道，“好了天行，就按我说的办。
至于后续的修炼资源，到时候我再给你想办法解决！”
得到父亲的保证，李天行心中顿时便有些普了，随即点头应道，“爹，天行明白了！”
得到李天行的回应后，李北玄心中依旧是有些不放心，于是便再次出言嘱咐一句，“对了，像青山这般出色的家族子弟，可不要吝啬了，每个月按最高规格提供其修炼之源，可明白了！”
李天行以及在座一众李家修士听到老祖所言，心中为之一震！
按照李家最高规格供应修炼资源，这可是他们李家头一次啊！
还有李青山的同辈修士们，此时也都是满眼羡慕看向李青山。
李青山的天赋本来就不错，这次若是得到家族顶级培养的话，绝对是会突飞猛进了！
content_en:
Li Beixuan was even more surprised when he saw Li Qingshan's excellent information panel.
If he hadn't been in the family hall at this moment, he would have exclaimed happily.
Blue qualification! A hundred percent breakthrough! There are also strong suggestions for cultivating entry prompts!
what does that mean!
This means that if he trains Li Qingshan, he can 100% break through the realm within a month!
As long as a clan member breaks through, his problem can be solved!
Regarding Li Qingshan's information panel, Li Beixuan became more and more satisfied with it.
After a while, he looked at Li Qingshan and couldn't help laughing loudly.
"Okay, okay, okay!"
Everyone present looked at each other, wondering why the ancestor suddenly burst out laughing.
Li Qingshan, who was being looked at by Li Beixuan, didn't understand why his ancestor looked at him for a while and then suddenly burst out laughing.
He looked at the ancestor and looked at him, his eyes full of doubts!
"As expected of the genius child of my Li family, you are very good!" Li Beixuan looked at Li Qingshan with a smile on his face and praised.
Hearing his ancestor's praise, Li Qingshan suddenly felt happy. It turned out that his ancestor just looked at him differently because of his outstanding qualifications!
Everyone else can now see why the ancestor laughed so loudly just now.
It turns out that it’s because some tribesmen have outstanding talents!
But after seeing that the clansman was Li Qingshan, they were all relieved.
"Dad, this clan member is the genius descendant Li Qingshan I mentioned to you just now. He is also the sixth generation descendant of our Li family!" Li Tianxing quickly introduced to Li Beixuan.
He also didn't expect that his father could see Li Qingshan's extraordinary qualifications at a glance.
"Yes!" Li Beixuan nodded to him, the smile on his face still undiminished.
Then, he looked at Li Tianxing and said, "Tianxing, use all the cultivation resources in the clan!
Starting from today, we no longer need to save money in our daily practice! "
"Especially when dealing with the talented children of my Li family, don't be stingy with spiritual resources, and focus on cultivating them!"
When Li Tianxing heard this, he was suddenly startled. He didn't expect that his father meant this!
With his father's instructions, he naturally had to comply, "Yes, Tian Xing knows! I will make arrangements later!"
But after thinking about it again, I felt something was wrong, so I continued to say to Li Beixuan, "But Dad, our spiritual source is probably only enough to support the people's cultivation for two months. What should we do after two months?"
When Li Beixuan heard that, Lingyuan could still support the Li family monks to practice for two months. Although it was a bit reluctant, it was enough to solve his urgent need.
So he looked at Li Tianxing and said, "Okay Tianxing, just do as I say.
As for the follow-up cultivation resources, I will find a solution for you when the time comes! "
After receiving his father's assurance, Li Tianxing suddenly felt enlightened, and then nodded and said, "Dad, Tianxing understands!"
After receiving Li Tianxing's response, Li Beixuan was still a little worried, so he once again told him, "By the way, outstanding family members like Qingshan should not be stingy and provide them with the source of cultivation according to the highest standards every month. I understand!"
Li Tianxing and all the Li family monks present were shocked when they heard what their ancestor said!
This is the first time for their Li family to provide cultivation resources according to the highest standards of the Li family!
Li Qingshan's fellow monks were also looking at Li Qingshan with envy at this time.
Li Qingshan's talent is already good. If he gets top training from his family this time, he will definitely improve by leaps and bounds!
